## Example: Marine sample processing

| Product family | Receive samples | Log metadata | Laboratory analysis | Quality review |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Passive acoustic recordings | 🟩 🔁 | 🟩 🔁 | 🟦 Custom detector | 🟩 🔁 |
| eDNA samples | 🟩 🔁 | 🟩 🔁 | 🟨 ⚠️ Changeover | 🟩 🔁 |
| Visual survey records | 🟩 🔁 | 🟩 🔁 | 🟦 Manual annotation | 🛑 Rework |

Green cells reveal the high-volume shared flow. Blue cells distinguish family-specific analysis, yellow draws attention to setup time, and the stop marker identifies a likely improvement target.
